messages:
maria_sales: Oliver from BetaCorp reporting streaming fails behind their corporate proxy. Works from laptop but service in k8s sees frequent ECONNRESET after ~30s. Can SE help triage?

oliver_cust: Using TS SDK @redwood/inference 0.13.0. stream.on('data') gets a few chunks then socket hang up. Curl from host shows proxy 502 after 29s.

devon_se: Likely proxy idle/response buffering. Quick checks: curl -v --no-buffer to streaming endpoint from same pod, and confirm HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY. Also try node https.Agent keepAlive true.

oliver_cust: Ran curl --no-buffer -> 502 at 29s. It's a corporate proxy appliance.

devon_se: Short-term fallback: switch to non-streaming polling for POC or detect stream failure and re-request final completion with prefix. For Node set agent: new https.Agent({keepAlive:true, maxSockets:5}).

nina_oncall: If they need it for demo, sales can temporarily raise request quota to avoid rate limit when polling. Maria?

maria_sales: OK to bump trial quota x2 for 48h. I'll update POC tracker.

oliver_cust: Thanks — we'll implement agent + fallback for demo and request proxy exception for production. Will post logs if it still fails.
